VERIFIED BOUNDED CHAIN: The June 28 Record introduces SA 2360 as an amendment to H.R. 1 and prints section 40012, headed SUPPORT FOR ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE UNDER THE BROADBAND EQUITY, ACCESS, AND DEPLOYMENT PROGRAM. Its opening amends section 60102 of division F of Public Law 117-58 (47 U.S.C. 1702). The June 30 Record explicitly identifies SA 2814 as an amendment to SA 2360 and gives its entire operative instruction: 'Strike section 40012.' Roll call 363 adopted that amendment on July 1, before roll call 371 adopted SA 2360 as amended. The later EAS document is headed 'July 1 (legislative day, June 30), 2025'; it is a later chamber-engrossed version, not a transcript of the exact text at the instant of roll call 371. Its Commerce title ends with section 40011 and continues directly into Title V and section 50101. Inspection of that published EAS found no numbered section 40012 heading. Its section 50404 is still headed TRANSFORMATIONAL ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE MODELS, so the evidence must not be summarized as removal of all AI-related provisions.
UNRESOLVED HISTORY: The full sequence of modifications between the original June 28 SA 2360 print, the strike, substitute adoption and later engrossment has not been reconstructed. The supplied opening of original section 40012 is not its complete text or a verified immediately-pre-strike version; it does not support quoting detailed grant conditions, a moratorium duration or exceptions. These records support the precise numbered target, the adopted strike, and its omission at the identified Commerce-title boundary in the later EAS, not a claim that every possible similar provision was absent everywhere or that the EAS was identical to the precise roll-call-371 snapshot. No enrolled/current-law version or later legal developments were reviewed for this case.
SEMANTIC ACCEPTANCE: Reconcile the printed instruction and both dated versions rather than inferring final text from a roll call. Distinguish Senate section 40012 from earlier House section 43201. Explain that the later package vote is not evidence of support for the original section 40012 as proposed; do not attribute every clause or individual motive to a package vote. State the actual EAS-version boundary and surviving AI-related section 50404 without inventing its unprovided substantive details. Preserve the incomplete intervening-history and enactment limits. Quote only supplied source passages, cite the source text and motions, and do not certify current law. This authored reference is not a model response or evidence of live-model accuracy.
